objective: Repair prospective useful-work evidence freshness, establish a strict current utilization baseline, and rank the dominant causes of under-utilization before selecting the next intervention.
acceptance_criteria: Current epoch produces qualifying useful-work evidence without historical inference.
Evidence append path rejects duplicate/overlap/naive-time inputs and is exercised by integrated CI.
Baseline and cause ranking distinguish observed useful time from unknown time.
checkpointable_substeps: Diagnose the epoch-43 evidence freshness gap.
Implement and test deterministic prospective evidence capture.
Persist current observed evidence and verify integrated CI.
Compute strict baseline and rank under-utilization causes.
Select next correction by expected effect on P001.
handoff_boundary: After each durable implementation/test/state mutation; scheduler-only timestamps and evidence bookkeeping alone are not useful-work evidence.
early_finish_fallback: Use the baseline to implement the highest-impact correction within the same P001 work spec rather than returning to nearby control simplification by inertia.
